$comment: ADR-0110 decision 3: the workflows a delegate of runward/delegation.md may dispatch or re-run, and the inputs it may pass. Each is verified to publish nothing and to write to nothing outside its run. A workflow with workflow_dispatch that is not listed refuses, in a first job every other job waits on, any run a delegate triggered; a listed workflow with a restricted input refuses a delegate's run outside it. test/unit/dispatch-allowlist.test.js holds this file, the refusals and the workflows together. It holds main's copy only: a dispatch on a branch ref runs that branch's copy.

mutation-ratchet.yml.why: One module measured, mode measure: the plan, measure and ratchet jobs read the tree and upload artifacts. An empty module runs the summary job, which signs a ratchet summary under id-token: write (a release's act, ADR-0079); mode gate is a release's verdict.

documented-commands.yml.why: contents: read; runs the guide's commands against a published release.

verify-release.yml.why: contents: read; read-only verification of a published release.

verify-artifact-roundtrip.yml.why: permissions: {} at the top, contents: read on one job; packs nothing, attests nothing, publishes nothing.
